_note: Exported once from the Godot build's godot/scripts/settings/schema.gd by engine/tools/export_settings_schema.py (its docstring explains the fields). The engine creates the cvars and generates the Settings page from it.

settings.label: Display mode
settings.tip: Windowed (a framed window), Borderless (a window without a frame), Full screen (a borderless window over the whole monitor), or Exclusive full screen (lowest latency).

settings.label: Window size
settings.tip: The window's size in Windowed and Borderless, shrunk to fit beside the taskbar. Full screen always uses the monitor's resolution; use Render scale to change the 3D resolution there.

settings.label: Monitor
settings.tip: Which monitor the game opens on.

settings.label: VSync
settings.tip: Off gives the lowest input latency. Adaptive syncs only when above the refresh rate.

settings.label: Frame cap
settings.tip: Maximum frames per second. 0 = uncapped. In Oz's matches, movement and fire rates are the same at any frame rate; on other servers they follow the server's rules (on most, jumps and strafing are tuned for 125).

settings.label: Recording-friendly display
settings.tip: Shows the game the way DirectX games do, so OBS, Discord and the Game Bar can record and stream it in every display mode. Off can reach higher frame rates above 500 fps, but recorders may show a black or frozen picture.

settings.label: Field of view
settings.tip: Horizontal degrees at 4:3, as cg_fov is. Wider screens see more at the sides (Hor+), so it's correct at any aspect.

settings.label: Render scale
settings.tip: 3D resolution relative to the window, scaled up by the Upscaler. The menu and HUD always render at full resolution.

settings.label: Upscaler
settings.tip: How the 3D image is scaled when render scale isn't 1.

settings.label: Brightness
settings.tip: Overall brightness of the 3D image.

settings.label: Contrast
settings.tip: Contrast of the 3D image.

settings.label: Preset
settings.tip: Sets every quality setting below. Classic keeps the original look (no AO, bloom or shimmer). Changing one of them switches this to Custom.

settings.label: Shadows
settings.tip: Shadow map resolution and filtering. Ultra also gives every map light a live shadow on players and the mist: barely visible, and several times slower. Applies when Settings closes (the renderer restarts).

settings.label: Screen-space reflections
settings.tip: Reflections on wet and polished floors. Applies when Settings closes (the renderer restarts).

settings.label: Ambient occlusion
settings.tip: Contact shadows in corners and creases (SSAO). Applies when Settings closes (the renderer restarts).

settings.label: Bloom
settings.tip: Glow around bright light and energy weapons.

settings.label: Anti-aliasing
settings.tip: Smooths jagged edges: FXAA by a pass over the picture, MSAA by sampling the edges (2, 4 or 8 times). MSAA applies when Settings closes (the renderer restarts).

settings.label: Anisotropic filtering
settings.tip: Sharpness of textures seen at an angle.

settings.label: Texture quality
settings.tip: Lower settings use smaller mipmaps (less video memory).

settings.label: Custom textures
settings.tip: Images you drop in your custom_textures folder replace the game's textures of the same name: wall01.png replaces wall01, whatever its format. Texture folder below opens it. Off on servers that only allow their own files. Applies when Settings closes (the renderer restarts).

settings.label: Model detail
settings.tip: How soon distant models switch to simpler meshes.

settings.label: Particles
settings.tip: Amount of smoke, sparks and embers.

settings.label: Effect intensity
settings.tip: Brightness of explosions, beams, flashes and their lights.

settings.label: Heat shimmer
settings.tip: Air ripples behind rockets and around explosions.

settings.label: Marks and decals
settings.tip: Bullet holes, burns and blood on walls.

settings.label: Gibs
settings.tip: Bodies burst into gibs on big hits (cg_gibs). Off: they burn away instead.

settings.label: Rail trail
settings.tip: How the railgun's shot is drawn. Classic is the original core and spiral; Glow adds a bright halo that lingers and spreads; Thick beam is one thick glowing beam; Core is the beam alone.

settings.label: Rail width
settings.tip: Thickness of the rail's core and halo.

settings.label: Lightning beam
settings.tip: Classic is the original bolt. Glow brightens it in a blue halo and lights up where it hits. Straight draws a steady glowing line instead of the flickering bolt, if you find the bolt distracting.

settings.label: Lightning width
settings.tip: Thickness of the lightning gun's beam.

settings.label: Lightning color
settings.tip: Color of every lightning beam you see, yours and everyone's: the Glow and Straight beams, the flare and light where they hit, the muzzle flare. The beam stays as bright; a dark color gives its hue. Classic keeps the original bolt.

settings.label: Missile trails
settings.tip: Classic is the original smoke. Enhanced adds a burning core to rockets and grenades and glowing trails to plasma and the BFG.

settings.label: Plasma color
settings.tip: Color of every plasma shot you see, yours and everyone's: the ball, its Enhanced trail, the ring, glow and scorch where it hits, the muzzle flare. It stays as bright; a dark color gives its hue.

settings.label: Explosions
settings.tip: Classic is the original flash and mark. Enhanced adds flying embers and lingering smoke to blasts, and a glow to energy hits.

settings.label: Blood
settings.tip: Off removes blood puffs, trails and stains. Heavy adds sprays of droplets.

settings.label: Master
settings.tip: Master volume.

settings.label: Music
settings.tip: Music volume.

settings.label: Effects
settings.tip: Effects volume.

settings.label: Announcer
settings.tip: Announcer volume.

settings.label: Menu sounds
settings.tip: Menu sounds volume.

settings.label: Menu music
settings.tip: The original soundtrack, shuffled, in the main menu.

settings.label: Menu ambience
settings.tip: A quiet ambient drone in the menu. The original menu had no music, so it's off by default.

settings.label: Mute when in background
settings.tip: Silence the game while its window isn't focused.

settings.label: Output device
settings.tip: Where sound plays.

settings.label: Hit sound
settings.tip: The beep when you hit an enemy. Pitch by damage beeps higher for small hits and lower for big ones.

settings.label: Spatial audio
settings.tip: 3D sound through OpenAL with HRTF: distant sounds muffled and placed more sharply left and right. Off is the original's mixer.

settings.label: Announcer
settings.tip: The voice: "Excellent!", "Impressive!", lead changes, warnings, the countdown and "Fight!".

settings.label: Toggle crouch
settings.tip: Tap to crouch instead of holding.

settings.label: Toggle zoom
settings.tip: Tap to zoom instead of holding.

settings.label: Stick deadzone
settings.tip: Controller stick deadzone, menus included.

settings.label: Stick look speed
settings.tip: Controller look speed at full tilt, in turns per second.

settings.label: Stick layout
settings.tip: Which controller stick moves and which looks.

settings.label: Sensitivity
settings.tip: Classic units: degrees per count = sensitivity x 0.022 (m_yaw). The cm/360 below is the distance for a full turn.

settings.label: Mouse DPI
settings.tip: Your mouse's DPI (counts per inch). Only used to show cm/360.

settings.label: Zoom sensitivity
settings.tip: Multiplier while zoomed.

settings.label: Acceleration
settings.tip: Like cl_mouseAccel: faster swipes turn further. 0 = off. Mouse look always reads the mouse raw, without Windows' pointer speed.

settings.label: Invert vertical
settings.tip: Mouse up looks down.

settings.label: Crosshair
settings.tip: The ten classic crosshairs or a vector shape.

settings.label: Size
settings.tip: Size in pixels at 1080p (cg_crosshairSize).

settings.label: Thickness
settings.tip: Line thickness of vector shapes, and the size of the center dot.

settings.label: Gap
settings.tip: Space in the middle of vector shapes.

settings.label: Center dot
settings.tip: Adds a dot in the middle, on every shape.

settings.label: Color
settings.tip: Crosshair color.

settings.label: Opacity
settings.tip: How solid the crosshair is.

settings.label: Color by health
settings.tip: Tints the crosshair by your health and armor, white to yellow to red, as the original's crosshair health option did. It takes the color's place.

settings.label: Outline
settings.tip: Dark outline so it reads on bright walls.

settings.label: Outline width
settings.tip: How far the dark outline reaches past the crosshair.

settings.label: Outline opacity
settings.tip: How dark the outline is.

settings.label: Hit flash
settings.tip: The crosshair flashes the hit color when you hit an enemy.

settings.label: Hit color
settings.tip: The color it flashes when you hit an enemy.

settings.label: Flash length
settings.tip: How long the hit flash takes to fade.

settings.label: Hit marker
settings.tip: A marker flashes around the crosshair in the hit color each time you damage an enemy.

settings.label: Per-weapon crosshairs
settings.tip: Use a different crosshair for each weapon.

settings.label: Gauntlet
settings.tip: Crosshair for the gauntlet when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

settings.label: Machine gun
settings.tip: Crosshair for the machine gun when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

settings.label: Shotgun
settings.tip: Crosshair for the shotgun when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

settings.label: Grenade launcher
settings.tip: Crosshair for the grenade launcher when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

settings.label: Rocket launcher
settings.tip: Crosshair for the rocket launcher when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

settings.label: Lightning gun
settings.tip: Crosshair for the lightning gun when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

settings.label: Railgun
settings.tip: Crosshair for the railgun when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

settings.label: Plasma gun
settings.tip: Crosshair for the plasma gun when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

settings.label: BFG10K
settings.tip: Crosshair for the bfg10k when per-weapon crosshairs are on.

settings.label: HUD preset
settings.tip: Layout of the HUD: Modern (glass panels and bars), Competitive (smaller, compact), Minimal (numbers only), or Classic (ammo, health and armor in one row).

settings.label: HUD scale
settings.tip: Size of the HUD.

settings.label: HUD opacity
settings.tip: Transparency of the HUD.

settings.label: Speedometer
settings.tip: Your speed in units per second, with the strafe-jump readout (speed at each takeoff and the gain on the last).

settings.label: Speedometer style
settings.tip: Arc gauge or a compact bar. The Competitive and Classic presets always use the compact bar.

settings.label: Item timers
settings.tip: Countdowns for the armors, Mega Health and powerups once they're taken, left of the screen.

settings.label: Damage numbers
settings.tip: Damage dealt floats over the target.

settings.label: Kill feed
settings.tip: Who killed whom, top right.

settings.label: Ammo bar
settings.tip: Ammo for every weapon along the bottom.

settings.label: Net graph
settings.tip: The lagometer, bottom right: frame timing above, snapshot ping below, with ping and frame time.

settings.label: Show FPS
settings.tip: Frame rate counter.

settings.label: Chat time
settings.tip: How long chat lines stay on screen. The chat key shows the recent history.

settings.label: Chat lines
settings.tip: Most chat lines shown at once while playing.

settings.label: Team chat only
settings.tip: Hide everyone's chat but your team's (cg_teamChatsOnly).

settings.label: Emoji
settings.tip: Show :codes: and smileys like :) in chat as emoji. Off shows them as typed.

settings.label: Switch on pickup
settings.tip: Switch to a weapon you pick up (cg_autoswitch).

settings.label: View bob
settings.tip: The view bobs as you run (cg_bobup/cg_bobpitch). In Oz's own game; a mod keeps its own setting.

settings.label: Damage view kick
settings.tip: The view tilts when you are hit, as the original does. Your shots keep going where you aimed, so with this on a hit throws the lightning gun beam off the crosshair. The red flash and the direction marker stay either way. In Oz's own game; a mod keeps its own setting.

settings.label: Gun preset
settings.tip: Sets every gun setting below. Classic is the original's place, on the right; Centered puts the gun in the middle; Low tucks it down into the corner, clear of the view. Changing one of them switches this to Custom.

settings.label: Gun position
settings.tip: Where your gun is drawn: on the right, in the center, on the left (mirrored), or hidden. Under every game, mods' too.

settings.label: Gun forward
settings.tip: Moves the gun away from you, deeper into the view, or back toward you.

settings.label: Gun side
settings.tip: Moves the gun sideways: toward the edge its side is on, or back toward the middle. In the center, toward the right.

settings.label: Gun height
settings.tip: Moves the gun up or down in the view.

settings.label: Gun pitch
settings.tip: Tips the muzzle up or down, turning the gun about its grip.

settings.label: Gun yaw
settings.tip: Turns the muzzle toward the middle of the screen, or away from it toward the edge.

settings.label: Gun roll
settings.tip: Leans the top of the gun toward the middle of the screen, or toward the edge.

settings.label: Gun field of view
settings.tip: Field of view the gun is drawn at, so it keeps one size whatever your Field of view. 0 draws it at your Field of view, as the original does. Lower draws it bigger and closer, higher smaller.

settings.label: Widescreen gun placement
settings.tip: With a Gun field of view of its own, the gun keeps as far toward the edge as on a 4:3 screen. Off draws it where a wide screen puts it, nearer the middle. At your Field of view the gun is already where 4:3 puts it.

settings.label: Force enemy model
settings.tip: Show every enemy as one model (cg_forceModel).

settings.label: Bright skins
settings.tip: Players drawn in one flat bright color: enemies in Enemy color, teammates in Team color.

settings.label: Enemy color
settings.tip: Bright skin color for enemies.

settings.label: Enemy outline
settings.tip: Enemies keep their own look, with an outline in Outline color around them. Teammates stay plain.

settings.label: Outline color
settings.tip: The color of the outline around enemies.

settings.label: Team color
settings.tip: Bright skin color for teammates.

settings.label: Spawn effects
settings.tip: Teleport flash when players spawn and teleport.

settings.label: Hit twitch
settings.tip: Players' upper bodies jerk to the side when they're hit, as in the original (CG_AddPainTwitch). Off keeps them steady.

settings.label: Intro movie
settings.tip: The id logo and intro when the game starts.

settings.label: Tier movies
settings.tip: Play the original tier movie when you finish a campaign tier.

settings.label: Record replays
settings.tip: Record every match you play (Profile > Replays). A match on your own game (bots, a match you host) is recorded whole: every player, watchable from any view. A match on someone else's server is recorded as your own view: only that server sees every player.

settings.label: Replays kept
settings.tip: How many recent replays stay, of each kind (your own games', other servers'). Older ones are deleted, except favorites, which stay forever.

settings.label: Death cam
settings.tip: While you're dead the camera follows your body, then shows who killed you with their player card. Respawning works as it always has.

settings.label: Spectator camera
settings.tip: How you see the player you follow while spectating: through their eyes, the chase camera behind them, or the cinematic camera, which picks its own shots (slow orbits, tracking shots, wide shots of the fight) and cuts to the action, with the auto-director choosing who to watch. Use item switches between them.

settings.label: Auto-director
settings.tip: While you spectate, the camera follows the action by itself: a flag carrier, whoever just fragged, the closest fight. Gesture turns it on and off.

settings.label: Region
settings.tip: Matchmaking region, and the Server Browser's first choice. Automatic finds matches in your closest region first and widens if the wait runs long; a named region stays strict.

settings.label: Max ping
settings.tip: Hide servers and matches above this ping (the Server Browser's filter).

settings.label: Interpolation
settings.tip: Delay before other players are drawn in an online match, which smooths their motion. Lower is sharper, higher is smoother.

settings.label: Connection speed
settings.tip: Bandwidth a server may send you (your rate userinfo).

settings.label: Online services
settings.tip: Friends, parties and presence. Off keeps you offline.

settings.label: Online server
settings.tip: Leave empty for the default. A local test server is ws://127.0.0.1:8787.

settings.label: Hide my IP
settings.tip: Peer-to-peer matches only: connect through the relay, so the other players see the relay's address instead of yours. Adds the relay's latency. A community server always sees your address.

settings.label: Check for updates
settings.tip: Ask GitHub when the menu opens whether a newer version has been released, and offer it.

settings.label: Update automatically
settings.tip: Download a new version in the background as soon as it's released (usually only the few MB that changed) and install it when you quit or restart. Off, the update waits for you to press Update. Every update is checked against the game's signing key first.

settings.label: Include beta releases
settings.tip: Also offer pre-releases. A beta build is always offered newer betas.

settings.label: Menu and text size
settings.tip: Size of the menus and their text (the HUD has its own scale). In a small window the menus grow only as far as they still fit.

settings.label: High-contrast menus
settings.tip: Solid backgrounds and brighter text in menus.

settings.label: Reduced flashing
settings.tip: Calms pulsing, embers, muzzle flashes and screen flashes.

settings.label: Colorblind mode
settings.tip: Shifts the game's colors so the ones your eyes confuse stay apart (a daltonize filter over the 3D and the HUD).

settings.label: Subtitles
settings.tip: Captions for the announcer, bottom middle.

settings.label: Subtitle size
settings.tip: Caption text size.

settings.label: Modern player models
settings.tip: Draws the fighters that have a new high-detail model with it: Doom, Visor and Anarki so far, on their own skeletons and animations. Experimental. Applies when Settings closes (the renderer restarts).

settings.label: Player name
settings.tip: Your name in matches.

settings.label: Character
settings.tip: Your character.

settings.label: Skin
settings.tip: Your character's skin. Team games paint you red or blue.

settings.label: Accent color
settings.tip: Your color: the menu's rim light and your rail trail.

preset_tables._note: A preset setting's columns, in its options' order (Custom left out): picking one sets each setting to its column's value; changing one of them makes the preset Custom. Graphics > Preset's are "presets" above.
